# ferriskey_federation_provider (Resource)

Manages a user federation provider (LDAP, Active Directory, Kerberos or custom) within a FerrisKey realm. User synchronization and connection tests are not managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_federation_provider" "ldap" {
  realm         = "acme"
  name          = "corporate-ldap"
  provider_type = "Ldap"
  sync_mode     = "Import"
  bind_password = var.ldap_bind_password

  config = jsonencode({
    connection = {
      server_url                 = "ldap://ldap.example.com"
      port                       = 389
      use_tls                    = false
      use_starttls               = false
      connection_timeout_seconds = 10
    }
    bind       = { bind_dn = "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com" }
    search     = { base_dn = "dc=example,dc=com", user_search_filter = "(uid={0})" }
    attributes = { username = "uid", email = "mail", first_name = "givenName", last_name = "sn" }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Provider configuration as a JSON document (use `jsonencode`). For LDAP this has the objects `connection`, `bind` (`bind_dn`), `search` and `attributes`. Do not put the bind password here: the API masks secrets, so use `bind_password` instead.
- `name` (String) Provider name.
- `provider_type` (String) Provider type: `Ldap`, `ActiveDirectory`, `Kerberos`, or any custom type string.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the provider belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `bind_password` (String, Sensitive) Password used to bind to the directory. It is injected into `config` as `bind.bind_password_encrypted`. The API never returns it, so it is tracked from configuration only.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `priority` (Number) Lookup priority among providers. Defaults to `0`.
- `sync_enabled` (Boolean) Whether periodic user synchronization is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `sync_interval_minutes` (Number) Interval between synchronizations in minutes.
- `sync_mode` (String) Synchronization mode: `Import`, `Force` or `LinkOnly`. Defaults to `LinkOnly`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{uuid}`.
- `provider_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_federation_provider.ldap acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
